headline: Indian Government Bond Yields Steady as Foreign Inflows Support Market
summary: Yields on India's benchmark 10-year government bond held steady at 7.2768% as sustained foreign buying balanced volatility in global crude oil and US Treasury markets.
why: Indian sovereign debt attracted global bond index inclusion, increasing sensitive foreign portfolio debt flows.

impacts.name: India 10-year sovereign bond yield
impacts.why: Foreign institutional inflows balanced external Treasury market movements.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Continued debt purchases by foreign funds anchored government bond prices against overseas yield moves.
